sentences.en: Raw Kids - Since it can be hard to get kids to eat anything that's perceived as different, this book focuses on not only recipes but guiding kids through the transition to raw foods as painlessly as possible.

sentences.en: Clipping your dog's nails can be stressful for you and your pet, so it's only natural that you'd find the idea of a product designed to help you trim your dog's nail easily and painlessly quite appealing.

sentences.en: In the era of the Internet, it is incredibly easy to collect a wide range of information quickly and painlessly.

sentences.en: Theoretically, the benefit would be that everyone who ate one of those tomatoes would be vaccinated against small pox quickly, painlessly, and inexpensively.

sentences.en: There is no need to worry; these crusts are similar to what you'd see on a scab, and like a scab, they fall off painlessly.
